about_the_game:
【Game Overview】

Hyper Euphoria is an adventure game where you advance the story by selecting commands like “Look,” “ Search,” and “Talk.” The protagonists, Mayuka Tendo and Elizabeth Tsuchigami, are detectives possessing the ability known as “Hyper Psychokinesis.” They investigate a series of murders. Enjoy graphics and character interactions that recreate the atmosphere of popular Japanese PC adventure games from the late 80s.

【Synopsis】

A body suddenly explodes in Suiyo Park, H City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan!

Concluding this was a murder involving “psychokinesis,” the local police commissioned two girls, “Psychokinetic Detectives” (detectives possessing “psychokinesis”), to investigate.

The investigation moves from Saitama Prefecture to Yamaguchi Prefecture, then to Hiroshima Prefecture. What will the girls ultimately witness...?

【Game Features】

・Design reminiscent of popular Japanese PC adventure games from the late 80s

・A story spanning 3 chapters, traveling across various regions of Japan

・Estimated playtime: Approximately 3 hours

・Pixel art visuals that will satisfy fans of classic adventure games

・Features FM sound source music by a stellar lineup of sound creators!

・An easy-to-use backlog function that even saves your selected commands, ensuring you never miss a message

・Includes epilogue content and a music mode to enjoy after clearing the game

Visuals:

Kodama Dai Gattai

Sound:

Shinichi Sakamoto

Shinji Hosoe

Ayako Sasō

content_descriptors.notes: This adventure game features a detective with psychic abilities as its protagonist. The game includes crime scene scenes rendered in pixel art that contain mild depictions of blood.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Higher
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 615
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: The command-selection adventure game that flourished back when PCs were still called microcomputers makes a comeback. Can you withstand the nonstop MAX 264km/h action that comes at you wave after wave!?
